title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Jira was unreachable; the local snapshot rfe-snapshot.md was used as the canonical source.
Screen names, routes, and the Input type / ASR dropdown layout are prototype inventions, not confirmed against the gen-ai-ui codebase.
Standalone build: no codebase was available, so no workspace clone or verification was run.
Images are JPG/PNG and audio is WAV/MP3 with a 10 MB limit per the RFE proposed default (requires PM confirmation).
Microphone capture is out of scope per the RFE; PDF input and native input_audio are out of scope.
Only one image or one audio file per conversation history, per the RFE.
Decision mode skip: design calls were made inline without a decision kit.
